patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Makes Google sign-in and Google APIs work by routing them to MicroG RE instead of Google Play services. Requires MicroG RE (app.revanced.android.gms) and a Google account added in it.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes Google sign-in and Google APIs work in the patched app by using MicroG RE instead of Google Play services. Requires MicroG RE to be installed.

patches_added.name: Disable update prompt
patches_added.description: Stops Fawesome Movies & TV (Android TV) from showing the "New version Available" dialog on every launch. The app reads the server's latest version code (Firebase remote-config key "versioncode_androidtv_googletv") and, when it is higher than the installed build, shows an update dialog before continuing into the app. This patch forces the app's own no-update path instead, so startup is unchanged and the nag is gone — nothing is added, the client just stops being told to update. On 19.7 the seam is SplashActivity.checkCurrentAppVersion() -> Utilities.updateAlert(); on 20.1 (R8-obfuscated, ViewModel rewrite) it is the splash view-model's version-check method, forced down its own proceed branch. Whichever matches the installed version is applied.
